title: Analytic Braess example
purpose: Verify the engine reproduces the published Braess example exactly (FF/UE/SO; with and without the added link)
primary_outcome: Exact agreement of path times and TSTT with analytic values (83 and 92 at demand 6) within 1e-6
planned_analysis: Exact comparison with tolerance; no statistics

title: Braess demand sweep
purpose: Find the demand interval where the added link raises UE travel time and compare FF/UE/SO across demand
primary_outcome: Computed paradox interval versus hand-derived (80/31; 80/9) within 1e-6
planned_analysis: Deterministic sweep of 48 demand values; exact boundaries

title: Grid collective excess (primary)
purpose: Measure R = TSTT/TSTT_SO - 1 for UE and FF on seeded BPR grids at matched demand levels
primary_outcome: Median R(UE) on 6x6 grids at rho=2 versus margin 0.01
planned_analysis: One-sided 95% percentile bootstrap lower bound of the median over 50 instances; paired contrasts; sensitivity S1-S3

title: Compliance and capacity sweep
purpose: Measure R under partial system-optimal compliance c and capacity scaling on the EXP-003 6x6 instances
primary_outcome: Paired median differences of R between consecutive compliance levels
planned_analysis: Paired bootstrap over 50 instances; monotonicity test

title: Single-link removal scan (optional)
purpose: Estimate the share of 4x4 grid instances with at least one Braess link under UE
status: planned (protocol draft; awaiting owner freeze; optional)
planned_analysis: Wilson interval; re-solve of flagged links at 1e-8
